name: entre.pontos
source:
In Miguel's case, you will live an everyday event of a young college student in conflict between his dreams and the fatigue of college.

On a bus trip like any other, everything can change. What can happen on this path?

[From [url=https://campus-studio.itch.io/entrepontos] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在米格尔的故事中，你将体验一名在梦想与大学疲惫之间挣扎的年轻大学生的日常。在一次普通的公交旅程中，一切都可能改变。这条路上会发生什么？

[来源：[url=https://campus-studio.itch.io/entrepontos]itch.io[/url]]
